```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(here)
library(tidyr)

analysis_dir <- here("analysis")

source(file.path(analysis_dir, "knitr.R"))
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "theme.R"))
theme_set(theme_paper(base_size = 12))
```

```{r load_data, include=FALSE}
source(file.path(analysis_dir, "data.R"))
```

# Number of clustering runs

```{r supp-num-runs, fig.height=5, fig.width=6.69}
num_runs_full <- metrics_new %>%
  filter(filtering == "manual") %>%
  select(dataset, method, d_cluster, num_runs_leiden, num_runs_louvain) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(num_runs_leiden, num_runs_louvain),
    names_to = "algorithm", values_to = "num_runs"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    algorithm = recode(algorithm,
      num_runs_leiden = "Leiden", num_runs_louvain = "Louvain"
    ),
    d_cluster = factor(d_cluster)
  )

num_runs <- num_runs_full %>% filter(d_cluster == 0)

ggplot(num_runs, aes(x = method, y = num_runs, colour = algorithm)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.4, position = position_dodge(0.7)) +
  facet_wrap(~dataset) +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Algorithm", values = c(Leiden = "#0077BB", Louvain = "#EE7733")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Method", y = "Number of runs") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(angle = 30, hjust = 1, vjust = 1.1))
```

# ANOVA: effect of method

```{r num-runs-anova}
fit <- aov(
  num_runs ~ algorithm + dataset + d_cluster + method,
  data = num_runs_full
)
summary(fit)
```

# Sample sizes

```{r num-runs-n}
num_runs %>%
  group_by(dataset, method, algorithm) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(!is.na(num_runs)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = algorithm, values_from = n) %>%
  arrange(dataset, method) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

# Convergence to the target number of clusters

The resolution search targets K + `d_cluster` clusters, where K is the number of ground-truth labels in a dataset.
We measure how far each search ended from its target, Δ = `n_clusters` - (K + `d_cluster`); a search converged when Δ = 0.
We only include runs with manual filtering.

```{r delta}
delta <- metrics_long_new %>%
  filter(filtering == "manual") %>%
  mutate(
    algorithm = recode(algorithm, leiden = "Leiden", louvain = "Louvain"),
    delta = cluster_misspec
  )

missed <- filter(delta, delta != 0)
```

`r nrow(missed)` of `r nrow(delta)` searches (`r round(100 * nrow(missed) / nrow(delta), 1)`%) missed their target, and `r sum(abs(missed$delta) == 1)` of those missed by a single cluster.
At `d_cluster = 0`, where the target is K itself, `r sum(missed$d_cluster == 0)` of `r sum(delta$d_cluster == 0)` searches missed.

## Distribution of Δ

Number of searches for each value of Δ.

```{r delta-table}
delta %>%
  count(dataset, method, algorithm, delta) %>%
  arrange(delta) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = delta, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(dataset, method, algorithm) %>%
  knitr::kable()
```

## Missed targets by method and `d_cluster`

Percentage of searches with Δ ≠ 0; each tile summarises the `r nrow(delta) / nrow(distinct(delta, dataset, algorithm, method, d_cluster))` parameter combinations of that method and `d_cluster`.

```{r supp-num-runs-delta, fig.height=5.5, fig.width=6.69}
miss_rate <- delta %>%
  group_by(dataset, algorithm, method, d_cluster) %>%
  summarise(pct = 100 * mean(delta != 0), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(miss_rate, aes(x = factor(d_cluster), y = method, fill = pct)) +
  geom_tile(colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = ifelse(pct > 0, round(pct), ""), colour = pct > 50),
    size = 2.8
  ) +
  facet_grid(algorithm ~ dataset) +
  scale_y_discrete(limits = rev(names(met_cols))) +
  scale_fill_distiller(name = "% missed", palette = "Purples", direction = 1) +
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c(`FALSE` = "black", `TRUE` = "white"), guide = "none"
  ) +
  labs(x = "d_cluster", y = "Method") +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom", legend.title.position = "top"
  )
```
